name: Spc_Start
notes: DP clear to $EF, decw $BB/$BC, queue ids, GAIN $07-$77, CONTROL/timers, $FC handler $132E, group vols, builtin dir/params, MVOL; Exit X=0 A=$40 Y=$1C; boot block 3 = $24 B

name: Spc_MainLoop
notes: Shadow tables $1700/$1711 match the listed order; EVOL doubling/quirk BRA, ports 0-3, fade timer, song/sfx track loops and groups, callers $0CF3/$0374 all checked

name: Spc_WriteDsp
notes: All 15 CALL and 3 JMP sites in the callers note match the trace; $12F2 is table entry $FD (reg Arg0 = Arg1); A/X/Y/PSW kept

name: Spc_ClearPorts01
notes: CONTROL $13 then $03 (timer bits stay 1, no reset); callers $0BA9, $08C7, JMP $0D42, $1079 confirmed; no flags touched

name: Spc_QueueCommand
notes: Filter ($00, $FE, $10-$17), full-queue overwrite of the last entry, echo via Y, callers incl. $03E0/$1308 checked. nit: at $1308 X is Spc_Unk12F9's pointer, not a track

name: Spc_RunQueue
notes: Copies entries to $8D-$90, push x around Spc_RunCommand ($08E6), stops at first id 0, frees run entries, Exit A=X=0, QueueEnd=0; callers $02F2/$036E/$1312

name: Spc_PollCommand
notes: Double read, movw of ports into $8D-$90, RunCommand split (echo, push order for RET, first-table high byte only), Exit X=0/Z=1; tables $1680/$16A0 checked

name: Spc_StartSong
notes: Steps 1-6, header-set copy/move (subw/cmpw/addw), DSP list via $1352/$1AED/$0A78, Arg1/Arg2 vs Audio_StartSong. nit: no tracks after restore -> new start; bit 1 is left as is

name: Spc_CmdFadeAll
notes: CALL $0E1A, CALL $0E22, JMP $0E2A; table $16C0 entry 0 = $0E11 (command $80); Arg0 steps / Arg1 volume as Spc_StartFade reads them

name: Spc_CmdFadeSong
notes: Marks $7F/$C0/$30 with X 0/2/4, entries 1-3; LocLoad $81 (0,$FF) and battle $81 ($40/$80) checked in bank C0. nit: $83's mark $30 covers voices 4-5 of group 8-13 only

name: Spc_CmdFadeSfxA
notes: Sub-entry of Spc_CmdFadeSong's header: UnkD0 |= $C0, X = 2 (group of tracks 14-15), JMP Spc_StartFade; table entry 2 (command $82)

name: Spc_CmdFadeSfxB
notes: Sub-entry: UnkD0 |= $30, X = 4, falls into Spc_StartFade; table entry 3 (command $83); JMP $0E17 from Spc_CmdFadeAll

name: Spc_StartFade
notes: Steps 0 or equal target: vol = target, fraction/delta 0; else unsigned SBC + C to Spc_FadeDelta, delta word, fraction 0; X saved around the call

name: Spc_FadeDelta
notes: Two DIVs give |A|*256/Arg0 (Y int, A frac), negation on C=0 after POP P, Exit flags (N/Z from MOVW), X=Arg0; all 9 call sites checked, all with steps in $8E

name: Spc_CmdTempoPitch
notes: $85 = SongPitch then $86; signed compare via $80 bias, set-at-once and fade paths, $0377 reads $AA; C2Scene_ObjAInit's $86 (0,0) checked; entries 5/6

name: Spc_CmdTempo
notes: Sub-entry under Spc_CmdTempoPitch's header: $AD steps, $AA/$A9 set, $AB delta from Spc_FadeDelta; signed compare; table entry 6 (command $86)

name: Spc_CmdSongPitch
notes: Same scheme on $AE-$B4, UnkD1=$FF on both paths; $0A78 scales tracks below $10 by $AF; callers $0E7F CALL and entry 7 confirmed

name: Spc_CmdSfxPitch
notes: MOV dp,A keeps the CMP flags; TSET1 $00D1 with $C0 & SfxVoices; $0A78 uses $B1 for X >= $1C only; Exit A/X/Y right; entry 9 ($89)

name: Spc_CmdVolumeBoost
notes: $FF+Arg0 carry into $87.3 (MOV1 keeps C), MVOL $7F/$40 both sides, MainLoop doubles EVOL on bit 3; Exit A/Y/X right; entry 14 ($8E)

name: Spc_CmdMono
notes: $87.0 = Arg0 != 0, UnkD0=$FF; $0A0D skips the pan; Menu_CfgEntry0 sends $F3 with Menu_CfgA3; entry 19. nit: mono gives L x$80, R x$7F, not quite equal

name: Spc_CmdStopAll
notes: CALL $0F17, CALL $0F3F, JMP $0F71 (StopSong, StopSfxA, StopSfxB); table entry 16 = $0F0E (command $F0); Exit as Spc_StopSfxB

name: Spc_CmdStopSong
notes: Checked KOF tset/KON+EON/PMON/NON tclr of non-sfx voices, $53/$54/$56/$58 cleared, $80/$BB/$BC=$FF; A=$FF; table80 entry 17, $0F0E/$14C1 calls verified

name: Spc_CmdStopSfx
notes: Exit says X = $1A, but with Arg0 bit 0 set it BBSes to Spc_StopSfxB which leaves X = $16. Fix: X = $1A (group A) or $16 (bit 0 set, through Spc_StopSfxB)

name: Spc_StopSfxA
notes: Checked $C0 group keyoff/tclr, tracks 15-14 -> $1DC1 ($EB) wait 2, X=$1A, callers $0F11/$104A/$14F3, C3 $F2 Arg0 0. nit: shared header Exit X wrong for CmdStopSfx path

name: Spc_StopSfxB
notes: Checked $30 group, ASL x2 to bits 7-6, tracks 13-12 -> Spc_TrackEndCmd wait 2, loop ends on VoiceBit.3, X=$16; callers $104D/$1521/$0F14/BBS $0F3C verified

name: Spc_CmdMuteSet
notes: Checked $F4: Mute=Arg0, UnkD0=$FF; table80 entries 20/24/25 = $0FA5/$0FAC/$0FB5 in ROM; X, Y unchanged

name: Spc_CmdMuteClear
notes: Checked TCLR Mute / TSET UnkD0 with Arg0, A = Arg0; reached via table80 entry 24 ($F8)

name: Spc_CmdMuteAdd
notes: Checked TSET Mute and UnkD0 with Arg0, A = Arg0; reached via table80 entry 25 ($F9)

name: Spc_CmdPause
notes: Checked ADSR1 bit7 loops (Y 5..$75), VOLL/VOLR zeroed, Flags87.4, $D0/$22/$BE-$CD cleared, exits A=X=Y=0 / A=Y=$85; GAIN $A0 rate 0 = frozen; BattleCD $F5 ok

name: Spc_XferReceive
notes: Checked seq wait/echo, header, $E0 end, <$1E00 -> mode 0, $2Fxx stops sfx, push/RET dispatch to table $1544 vs ROM. nit: mode-7 sender Audio_CmdLoadSong missing from list

name: Spc_XferHeader
notes: Checked Flags88.0 -> $1326, CPUIO1 mode echo then CPUIO0, $EE busy on first step. nit: the pushes are at $1059/$105C ($1057/$105A load the bytes)

name: Spc_XferTriples
notes: Checked self-modified stores (3 operands), echo after CPUIO1, Y>=$80 -> base+$80 via EOR, $E0 RET, $FF/$F0 -> CmdControl $10C9. nit: Y is $81/$82/$80 when it advances

name: Spc_XferLive
notes: Checked identical to Triples plus T0OUT poll -> $0415 with X/Y saved; mode 5 used by $70 (UploadBlock2F00) and $71 (CmdSwapSample); JMP $1144

name: Spc_XferWords
notes: Checked two self-modified stores, echo after CPUIO1/2 read, Y wrap bumps both high bytes, end/reset handling, JMP $11AE; 65816 word steps match

name: Spc_XferBytes
notes: 'the first pass echoes the header's value again' is false: Spc_XferHeader waits for CPUIO0 to change and settles X to the first data step, so it echoes that step. Drop the clause

name: Spc_XferSkip
notes: Checked echo/settle loop, bit7 clear repeats, $E0 RET with A=X=$E0, $FF+$F0 -> CmdControl $1202; table entries 0/4/6 = $11E4; driver ends $1DEE < $1E00

name: Spc_XferMove
notes: Says the moves are from Audio_CmdSwapSample, but $71 sends only modes 5 and 2; mode 7 is Audio_CmdLoadSong's slot compaction (src, dest, length steps). Fix the name

name: Spc_XferNextStep
notes: Checked BEQ $1295 -> $129B ($60 = CLRC) branch-into-operand, C=1 path Y=$60 X=$E0, A=$F0 after non-reset $FF, calls $120C/$1262/$126D

name: Spc_CmdTimer
notes: Checked C = Arg0!=0 -> Flags88.5 (MOV1), divider $01/$2A, CONTROL $02 then $03 around T0TARGET; $0377 skips tempo on 88.5; entry 22

name: Spc_CmdSongCond
notes: Checked $D2 = Arg0 & $0F, readers at $1D05 and $1D2E compare it; table80 entry 8 = $12B6

name: Spc_CmdControl
notes: Checked Arg0 1 -> Flags88.7 = Arg1!=0 (MainLoop -> $1438), $F0 -> FLG=$E0, CONTROL=$80, JMP $FFC0; six JMP sites and entry 31 verified

name: Spc_NullCommand
notes: Checked lone RET; table10 entries 2,3,6,7,10-15 and table80 entries 4,10-13,15,23,26,27 = $12DD in ROM. nit: title lacks the address range/ROM per STYLE
